statement: People may need a clearer way to understand the status of a time-sensitive service request.
target_segment: People who submit time-sensitive service requests.
context: When a request is pending and the person does not know the next step.
desired_outcome: Understand the current status and what action, if any, is needed.
current_workarounds: Contact the service provider for an update.
notes: Synthetic template only; not a validated user opportunity.
